input.description: Telemetry shows cabin_temp_c climbing steadily from ~2°C to 5.8°C over 3 hours while controller_reading_c stays oscillating tightly around the 2°C setpoint (1.8-2.2°C) — the controller "believes" it is holding setpoint even as the cabin diverges, and compressor current is actually tapering off (11.1A→8.5A), confirming the controller is under-cooling based on a stale/miscalibrated sensor reading rather than actual cabin conditions. This matches KB-003's documented pattern for controller sensor calibration drift, for which the fix is a diagnostic reset to re-run self-calibration. KB-003 explicitly excludes this fix when controller reading tracks the cabin probe (that would indicate a refrigeration circuit fault needing a technician instead) — here the two readings clearly diverge, so the diagnostic-reset branch applies. No conflicting KB entries were found and no prior service history exists for this unit.
